tasks.title: Implement homepage entry center static prototype
tasks.forbidden_scope_note: Do not modify worklog, brief, phase-prd, UNIT-1, design, test-cases, QA/signoff/delivery-state/consistency-audit-result, plan, tasks, registry, or projection manifest from this developer task.

acceptance_targets.target: Password, verification-code, and QR login tabs can be switched in the prototype; the selected method is visibly active after repeated switching and the prototype_only/not_integrated boundary remains visible.
Renewal prompt is visible, can be dismissed or collapsed, can be restored for review, and repeat operations do not break the layout or imply real payment integration.
Client download entry is recognizable, click feedback is visible, repeat clicks remain local, and no actual download or external navigation is triggered.
Support entry is visible on desktop and mobile, click feedback is visible, repeat clicks remain local, and mobile feedback does not obscure core login or renewal areas.
Announcement or notice content is visible or expandable, does not cover login, renewal, download, or support entries, and stays marked as prototype-only content.
Desktop 1440x1000 and mobile 390x844 layouts keep login, renewal, download, support, and announcement entries identifiable, usable, and free of blocking horizontal overflow.

acceptance_targets.ac_ref: AC-LOGIN-SWITCH AC-RENEWAL-PROMPT AC-DOWNLOAD-ENTRY AC-SUPPORT-ENTRY AC-ANNOUNCEMENT-DISPLAY AC-RESPONSIVE
acceptance_targets.target: After switching login mode, dismissing renewal prompt, clicking download/support, and expanding announcement content, browser refresh returns to a safe documented default state and the interaction sequence works again.

proving_command: Open http://127.0.0.1:4173/ in a real browser.
Run browser QA commands or equivalent DevTools automation against desktop 1440x1000 and mobile 390x844 viewports.

Capture screenshots and interaction notes for login tab switching, renewal dismiss/restore, download repeat clicks, support repeat clicks, announcement visibility or expansion, responsive behavior, and refresh recovery.

required_evidence: RED/GREEN/REFACTOR evidence for each acceptance target
desktop 1440x1000 real-browser screenshot or screenshot reference
mobile 390x844 real-browser screenshot or screenshot reference
interaction notes for login tab switching
interaction notes for renewal dismiss and restore
interaction notes for download and support repeat clicks
confirmation that no backend, auth, payment, download, support, announcement, telemetry, release, or rollback integration was added

tasks.mock_boundary_note: Mock must not be used to prove acceptance or integration. Acceptance evidence requires a real browser over the local static prototype; all backend-facing behavior remains prototype_only or not_integrated.
